marketing_spend.source: Novadata daily margin export (Amazon Ads spend, auto-updated)
marketing_spend.note: Spend per unit = total ad spend / total units ordered over the window, per SKU x marketplace. Refreshed daily by the update_marketing_spend GitHub Actions workflow. SKUs with spend but zero units are treated as having no per-unit spend.

elasticity.source: Novadata daily export (12m) + Seller Central promotions report
elasticity.method: log-log OLS (SVD + rank check) per SKU x marketplace on posted price (0.10 grid) with promo-day, ad-spend and seasonality controls; empirical-Bayes shrinkage to country/global prior; wrong-sign fits fall back to prior; associational, not causal
